notes: catalog.uah.edu renders client-side and returned only navigation text to automated fetch, and older checksheet URLs return 404, so the frame comes from the 2026-27 checksheet PDF (which says the UAH Catalog is the final authority). Frame choice: C1 = CS 104 (first required programming course), C2 = CS 121, C3 = CS 417, C4 = CS 499; CS 221 (data structures) is also required and could be argued for C2. Few UAH course pages are public; most use Canvas. C5 = CS 430 (AI concentration requirement, elective otherwise); C6 = CS 490 (required OS).
